analysis.description: This paper investigates the effects of deliberate reward gifting in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings. The authors empirically demonstrate that such mechanics can improve learning progression in resource appropriation settings and discuss the impacts on learning dynamics.

type.justification: The study involves empirical experiments in the Harvest environment to demonstrate the effects of gifting mechanics on learning progression.
type.quote: We demonstrate empirically that agents with a simple zero-sum gifting mechanic achieve a dramatically improved learning progression in the Harvest environment.

name.justification: The research focuses on multi-agent reinforcement learning, as indicated by the investigation of interactions between multiple learning agents within a shared environment.
